tools.name: check_ingredients
tools.description: Check an ingredients list. Takes the ingredients exactly as printed on the pack. Returns an overall verdict, a verdict for each school, and every flagged ingredient with the reason.

tools.name: check_product_by_barcode
tools.description: Check a product by barcode. Looks the barcode up in Open Food Facts, then Open Beauty Facts, and checks its ingredients.

tools.name: explain_ingredient
tools.description: Explain one ingredient or E-number. For example 'E471', 'carmine', 'prawns', 'whey' or 'alcohol denat'. Returns the verdict for each school and the reasoning.

tools.name: screen_stock
tools.description: Is this stock halal? Screens a US-listed stock via Mizan: first the business (each standard's excluded industries), then the AAOIFI, Dow Jones Islamic, S&P Shariah and MSCI Islamic debt screens. A company name also works (nvidia, philip morris). Links to halal alternatives in the same industry.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_ingredients" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
